title: TODO graph cache (build/todo-cache.json)
description: Per-node shape emitted by scripts/todo-graph/build.py. The cache is a JSON array of these nodes, sorted by file_path. This schema is the optional companion to the per-file frontmatter spec at docs/infrastructure/todo-metadata.schema.json: that one constrains hand-authored frontmatter; this one constrains the generator's output. The forbidden-field validator in build.py rejects hand-authored copies of any field marked cache-only here (created_at, last_active_at, stamped_items).

file_path.description: Repo-relative path of the TODO. minLength is load-bearing, not decoration: both cache readers build occurrence keys from this field, so an empty one produces a keyed-on-nothing occurrence rather than a refusal (TODO-06 section 17).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from git log (cache-only; rejected in frontmatter).

last_active_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from git log (cache-only; rejected in frontmatter).

stamped_items.description: Per-`[x]` checklist-item records. Emitted only when the body has at least one [x] item; absent when no items have shipped. Cache-only -- never legal in hand-authored frontmatter (build.py forbidden-field check enforces).

item_idx.description: 0-based ordinal of the [x] item within the section (skips [ ] / [/]).

item_text.description: Full prose after the `[x] ` prefix (preserved, not truncated).

file.description: Optional: paired with the FIRST file ref in the same item so consumers (e.g. lint Check 7) can resolve symbol-only stamps deterministically. Absent when the item names a symbol with no nearby file reference.
